threads.subject: Following up from MFG Ops Expo

messages.body: Dana - good talking at the expo. You described the Monday spreadsheet ritual and I haven't stopped thinking about it. We built Harborview for exactly that. 30 minutes this week to see if it's a fit?
Worth a look. Adding Leo Nakamura, our eng lead - anything ops adopts, he has to live with. Monday the 16th, 10am central?

threads.subject: Re: Discovery call recap + API docs

messages.body: Recap attached. Leo - API docs and SAP connector spec included as promised. Dana - whenever Marcus has 40 minutes, we'll run the full demo.
Docs look solid. Found two field types in our WMS payloads that won't map cleanly - details at the demo.
Marcus is in for Wednesday the 25th. Calendar invite sent.
Sam - exports from all three plants are in your secure upload. Toledo's is ugly, don't say I didn't warn you.
Received. Toledo's is genuinely creative, but the mapper handles it. Sandbox on track for Monday.
Jordan - Ines Farah, procurement. Marcus asked me to start our vendor pass early. Please send: W-9, insurance certs, your standard MSA, and SOC 2 report. Standard review is two weeks.
All four attached. Happy to connect our legal with yours directly if anything in the MSA needs discussion.
Package looks complete. Two standard redlines on the MSA coming from legal, nothing controversial. We'll be ready when the proposal lands.
Jordan - sandbox verdict from Leo is a clear pass. Marcus wants the proposal by April 15 so we can approve before end of quarter. Both pricing paths like Ava discussed, please.
You'll have it by the 13th. Thanks for keeping this moving so cleanly, Dana.
